preconditions.description: The length of the paths is between 2 and 1,000,000.
Both paths have exactly n-1 moves.

preconditions.expression: all(move in 'NESW' for move in path1) and all(move in 'NESW' for move in path2)
preconditions.description: All moves in both paths are either 'N', 'E', 'S', or 'W'.

postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', both marbles can reach the end of their respective paths simultaneously.
If the output is 'NO', it is not possible for both marbles to reach the end of their respective paths simultaneously.
